dispatcher: Orchestrator (production run 34987389408 for 20260915130626 refused by classify_sql on a non-CASCADE DROP FUNCTION); production run 34989644100 for 20260915143302 (#2911) refused a nullable ADD COLUMN as interrupting
goal: Stop the production business-risk gate refusing ordinary additive migrations: exempt DO-free non-CASCADE DROP FUNCTION/PROCEDURE with signatures from data loss, and treat nullable no-default ADD COLUMN, new-table indexes/RLS/policies/grants and CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY as non-interrupting, while defaults, NOT NULL, CHECK, FK, type changes, non-concurrent indexes on existing tables, every other DROP and row-changing statements stay reported. DO block bodies, CALL, COPY, OWNER TO and a plain index after CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS are reported. Statement kinds the rules do not model (SELECT/EXECUTE of code, ALTER SEQUENCE/VIEW/FUNCTION/TYPE, CREATE ROLE and similar) report data loss and interruption by default.
assumptions: Postgres refuses a non-CASCADE DROP FUNCTION/PROCEDURE while dependents exist, so it removes no rows.
A nullable ADD COLUMN of a built-in type with no default is a catalog-only change.
sql_top_level_statements removes comments and dollar bodies; any DO block disables the drop exemption.
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, rehearsal, production, migration, claim, lease, or infrastructure write or dispatch.
Do not change the preview-required check.
Do not weaken, skip or quarantine any test.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix requires changing any file outside the gate script, its test file and the evidence pair.
